project.description: Stops only the monitoring stack (Prometheus/Grafana/exporters) for the all-in-one deployment, without touching app containers. Exits cleanly (0) when monitoring was never installed -- monitoring/stop-monitoring.sh checks for $DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR/monitoring/docker-compose.monitoring.yml first and just prints "monitoring not installed; nothing to stop" otherwise. Does not touch the Prometheus/Grafana data volumes (TSDB history and Grafana state persist across stop/start cycles). Start PIC-SURE / Stop PIC-SURE already start/stop this stack implicitly via the same opt-in check; this job exists for monitoring-only cycling without touching the rest of the platform.
